title: •Aved Luun
caption: •Aved Luun (V)
game_text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Adds one battle destiny with Kalit. Your Jawas and sandcrawlers are destiny +2. May ▼ one Jawa Camp, Sergeant Doallyn, or Thedit.
lore: Shaman of her Jawa tribe. Mate of Kalit. Suspects betrayal from her mate’s rival, Wittin.
